hollerith-tabulator-census.description: A woman in a dark high-necked dress sits in profile at a wooden desk, feeding a punched card into a metal press. Behind her is a tall wooden cabinet with rows of round dials, some lit, and a candle burns at the top right. Stacks of paper cards sit on the desk and in drawers, and the scene is painted in dim, warm browns. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible letters or border.

de-forest-triode-audion.description: A man with slicked-back dark hair, in a dark waistcoat and rolled white sleeves, bends over a wooden workbench wiring a small board. In the foreground a large glowing glass bulb-like vacuum tube with a bright filament sits on the table, with copper coils, a lit oil lamp, glass jars, a dark wooden box and headphones around it. The setting is a dim, cluttered workshop with warm lamplight, in a painterly oil style. No frame or text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

eccles-jordan-flip-flop.description: An oil-painted still life of two glass vacuum tubes standing on a wooden board. The left tube glows orange-red inside while the right one is dark. Copper wires and small resistors link the two tubes, and dim battery-like boxes and tools sit in the shadowy background. There is no visible text, frame or border, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bush-differential-analyzer.description: A dim workshop with brick walls and a hanging lamp. A man in a white shirt, dark tie and rolled sleeves bends over a long machine of horizontal steel shafts, brass gears and glass wheel-discs, adjusting a gear. At the right edge, a second man in shirtsleeves draws a curve with a pen on graph paper on a wooden table. The machinery and clothing look early twentieth century. No text or frame is visible; the painting runs edge to edge.

zuse-z3-computer.description: A dim, old-fashioned room with a wooden desk holding a small keyboard-like console and a reel of punched film or tape. Two tall open glass-fronted cabinets are packed with rows of small cylindrical components and wiring. Papers with diagrams lie on the floor, with curtains, a lamp and a doorway in the background. No people are visible, and no legible text is visible.

manchester-baby-runs-program.description: Two men in white shirts with rolled sleeves lean toward a rack of electronics. A round green-glowing screen in the middle shows a faint grid of dots. Racks on both sides are packed with glowing vacuum tubes, cables and meters. Dark, oil-painted style, with no visible text and no frame.

univac-i-delivered.description: A dim, moody oil-style painting of a man in a dark suit seated at a large control console covered in switches and small indicator lights, with a teleprinter-style typewriter unit in front of him. Behind him stand tall grey cabinets with reel-to-reel tape drives, and loose cables run across the floor. The room is dark and cluttered with a few overhead lights, and the painting fills the whole image with no visible frame or border.

kilby-first-integrated-circuit.description: An oil-style painting of a small dark circuit assembly on a clear glass plate, with fine gold wires joining metal pads, set on a dark wooden bench. A brass microscope and a glowing lamp sit above, with a soldering iron or probe on the right and an old knobbed instrument at top left. No legible text is visible, and the painting fills the frame edge to edge.

ibm-system-360-announced.description: A painted interior of a computer room. In the foreground a man in a white shirt and dark trousers leans over a console with a panel of blinking lights and switches, reading a paper. Beside him a man in a dark suit stands at the console. Behind them rows of boxy blue-grey cabinets, several with open reel tape drives, stretch back into a dim room with fluorescent ceiling lights and cables on the floor. Other people in office clothes are at desks in the background.

apple-ii-released.description: A young person with shaggy brown hair and a patterned shirt sits at a wooden desk typing on a beige plastic computer with a built-in keyboard. A small CRT monitor on top shows a simple green and pink blocky picture, and a cassette recorder sits beside the machine. The room behind is dark, with bookshelves and a framed picture in the top left corner. The style is a dark oil painting that fills the frame edge to edge.

ibm-pc-launched.description: A painted, dimly lit office desk with a beige boxy desktop computer, a CRT monitor on top showing green text, and a separate beige keyboard in front. A hand is pushing a black floppy disk into the drive slot on the case, and stacks of floppy disks and loose papers sit on the desk. A green desk lamp glows at the left and a lamp at the upper right. The case has a small 'IBM' badge. Edge to edge, no frame.

arm1-processor-first-runs.description: A dim, candlelit electronics workbench painting. A analog multimeter with a needle dial and red and black probes sits at left, with a lit candle behind it. At the back sits a beige 1980s desktop computer with a CRT monitor and a floppy drive. In the centre, a green circuit board holds a large square chip in a ceramic package, surrounded by ribbon cables, capacitors and resistors. Notebooks with scribbled handwriting lie at the edges. No people are visible.

imac-launched.reason: The word 'iMac' is clearly legible on the bezel below the screen. Repaint the chin without any lettering.
imac-launched.description: An oil painting of a rounded, translucent teal-and-white all-in-one computer with a handle on top, its internals visible through the shell, on a wooden table beside a round clear mouse, in a dim kitchen with cabinets and clutter. The word 'iMac' is legibly painted on the bezel below the screen. No frame, no people, nothing graphic.

nvidia-geforce-256-gpu.description: A painting of an open beige desktop PC case seen from above and to the side. A green circuit-board graphics card with a black fan and metal heatsink sits seated in a slot, with RAM sticks, a power supply, and ribbon and power cables around it. Two beige CRT monitors on the desk show low-poly green and blue landscapes, and a desk lamp glows at the top. The scene is dim and warm, with no people and no legible text.

ibm-quantum-factors-15.description: A large brass-and-steel cylindrical vessel with pipes and cables dominates the left, topped with fittings. A gloved hand reaches in from the top right holding a small glass vial. On the right sits a beige CRT monitor showing a spectrum of sharp peaks and a waveform, with a keyboard in front. The room is dark and painterly, lit by a warm beam from above, with no visible text.

roadrunner-petaflop-supercomputer.description: A long aisle of dark server racks with blinking green and blue indicator lights runs into the distance. Cable bundles hang overhead in trays, and a lone man in a dark shirt and jeans, with a lanyard, walks away down the centre on a perforated metal floor, holding a small light. It is a modern data-centre setting in a painterly style, with no visible text or frame.

ibm-watson-jeopardy.description: A dark, painterly TV studio stage with two silhouetted men in suits seen from behind at side podiums. Behind them is a large wall of glowing blue answer panels, and a crowd sits in the shadowed audience. In the centre a tall lit monitor on a pedestal shows a glowing swirl of orbital rings and a bright green-blue globe. Spotlights hang from a metal truss overhead. No legible text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

raspberry-pi-released.description: A boy with short hair and a dark sweater leans over a wooden table in a dim room, pushing a black cable into a green circuit board with a silver-cased chip and small ports, a Raspberry Pi-style board. Beside it sit a beige keyboard, a bulky CRT monitor with a glowing screen, and a tangle of cables including a yellow RCA plug. A second child sits at a desk in the blurred background in front of a dark chalkboard. The style is an oil painting with visible brushwork, and the scene is edge to edge with no frame.
